title: Brief special meeting authorizes closed session
subtitle: Closed session on a labour relations matter and a property security matter; no public business or delegations.
overview: Council held a short special meeting on April 7, 2025. It began at 4:18 p.m. and adjourned at 4:19 p.m. The Mayor chaired the meeting and gave the Land Acknowledgement. No one declared a pecuniary interest, and the Mayor had no business or updates to report.

The only decision was to authorize a closed (in-camera) session immediately after the special meeting. Council approved this {{vote:m1}}. The session was to consider a labour relations matter, a security of property matter, and information that belongs to the municipality and has monetary value. These topics fall under the Municipal Act, 2001, Sections 239 (a), (b) and (j).

For residents, this meeting made no public policy, spending or service decisions. The minutes report no outcome from the closed session, so there is nothing further to summarize. Any later decisions on these matters would appear in future public records.

decisions.detail: Council authorized a closed session after the special meeting to consider a labour relations matter, a security of property matter, and municipal information with monetary value, under Section 239 (a), (b) and (j) of the Municipal Act, 2001.
